name: slack-gif-creator
headline: Obsidian Skills for Enhanced Productivity
short_description: Obsidian-skills offers a collection of powerful agent skills tailored for the Obsidian note-taking platform. Enhance your productivity and streamline workflows with these innovative tools designed for integration.
author: kepano

sections.overview:
Obsidian-skills is a collection of Agent Skills specification-compatible tools that extend Obsidian's capabilities to AI agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex CLI. The skill suite includes four core tools: obsidian-markdown for creating and editing Obsidian Flavored Markdown with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, and properties; obsidian-bases for working with Obsidian Bases including views, filters, and formulas; json-canvas for creating and editing JSON Canvas files with nodes, edges, and connections; and obsidian-cli for vault interaction including plugin and theme development. These skills integrate directly into your Obsidian vault workflow, allowing agents to automate note creation, database management, and canvas visualization tasks while maintaining Obsidian's native syntax and features.
Automate the organization of notes based on tags and categories.
Enhance content creation by generating templates and suggestions.
Streamline project management by linking tasks and deadlines within notes.
Integrate with external productivity tools like Trello or Notion for a unified workflow.
sections.usage:
```
Help me create a new Obsidian vault for [PROJECT NAME] with the following structure: [DESCRIBE STRUCTURE]. Include daily notes, weekly reviews, and project-specific folders. Also, suggest 5 plugins that would be most useful for this workflow.
```
Copy

```
Based on your request, I've created a comprehensive Obsidian vault structure for your 'Q3 Marketing Campaign' project. The vault includes the following folders: Daily Notes, Weekly Reviews, Content Ideas, Competitor Analysis, and Performance Metrics. For daily notes, I've set up a template with sections for tasks, insights, and action items. The weekly review folder contains a template for reflecting on progress, challenges, and next steps. I've also included a 'Resources' folder for saving relevant articles and data. Recommended plugins for this workflow are: Dataview for data organization, Templater for custom templates, Calendar for scheduling, Kanban for task management, and Excalidraw for visual planning. This structure will help you stay organized and track your marketing campaign's progress effectively.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
